title_zh: 新产业新赛道培育发展
title_en: Cultivation and Development of New Industries and New Tracks

blocks.zh: 集成电路
blocks.en: Integrated Circuits

blocks.zh: 做精做细成熟制程，提高先进制程制造能力，加快发展关键装备、材料和零部件，发展高性能处理器和高密度存储器。加快宽禁带半导体产业提质升级，推动氧化镓、金刚石等超宽禁带半导体产业化发展。推进存算一体、三维集成、光电融合等技术突破应用。
blocks.en: Refine mature-process nodes and enhance advanced-process manufacturing capabilities; accelerate the development of key equipment, materials and components; and develop high-performance processors and high-density memory. Accelerate the upgrading of the wide-bandgap semiconductor industry and promote the industrialization of ultra-wide-bandgap semiconductors such as gallium oxide and diamond. Advance breakthroughs in and the application of technologies such as computing-in-memory, 3D integration and optoelectronic convergence.

blocks.zh: 具身智能
blocks.en: Embodied Intelligence

blocks.zh: 统筹布局具身智能实训场，推进虚实融合的协同训练与进化，深入研究物理人工智能，研发大小脑一体化的具身模型与算法，攻关本体及核心零部件等关键技术，加速人形机器人等各类形态产品升级和应用落地。
blocks.en: Make coordinated arrangements for embodied intelligence training grounds, advance collaborative training and evolution that integrates the virtual and the real, deepen research on physical AI, develop embodied models and algorithms integrating large and small brains, achieve breakthroughs in key technologies such as bodies and core components, and accelerate the upgrading and application of products in various forms, including humanoid robots.

blocks.zh: 生物制造
blocks.en: Biomanufacturing

blocks.zh: 突破酶制剂、生物种质智能设计、智能发酵等关键技术，推进生物育种、生物化工、生物医药、生物能源等技术创新应用。加快细胞和基因治疗药物、抗体药物、核酸药物、放射性药物等研发应用，提升应急疫苗和药物研产用能力。
blocks.en: Achieve breakthroughs in key technologies such as enzyme preparations, intelligent design of biological germplasm and intelligent fermentation, and promote technological innovation and application in biological breeding, biochemicals, biopharmaceuticals and bioenergy. Accelerate the R&D and application of cell and gene therapy drugs, antibody drugs, nucleic acid drugs and radiopharmaceuticals, and enhance the capacity to research, produce and use emergency vaccines and drugs.

blocks.zh: 新型电池
blocks.en: New-generation Batteries

blocks.zh: 加快高容量电极材料、高电导率电解质材料、复合集流体等关键材料攻关，研发高精度涂覆、高速叠片等高端制造设备及工艺，拓展高安全高能量密度电池在新型智能终端、新型储能、电动交通工具等领域应用。
blocks.en: Accelerate breakthroughs in key materials such as high-capacity electrode materials, high-conductivity electrolyte materials and composite current collectors; develop high-end manufacturing equipment and processes such as high-precision coating and high-speed stacking; and expand the application of high-safety, high-energy-density batteries in new intelligent terminals, new energy storage, electric transport and other fields.

blocks.zh: 商业航天
blocks.en: Commercial Space

blocks.zh: 推进大功率能源系统、通用星载计算机和箭体结构轻量化、星箭联合设计、可重复使用运载等技术攻关，提升星箭产品规模化生产和商业航天发射能力。加强太空主动防御、群体智能操控等技术研发应用，提高太空安全态势感知和风险防范能力。
blocks.en: Advance breakthroughs in technologies such as high-power energy systems, general-purpose onboard computers and lightweight rocket structures, integrated rocket-satellite design, and reusable launch; enhance the large-scale production of rocket and satellite products and commercial space launch capacity. Strengthen the R&D and application of technologies such as active space defense and swarm intelligent control, and improve space situational awareness and risk prevention capabilities.

blocks.zh: 国产大飞机
blocks.en: Domestically Produced Large Aircraft

blocks.zh: 推进C919飞机产能提升和供应链建设，开展C919高原型等系列化机型、C909衍生型、新能源飞机研制应用，加快C929飞机技术攻关和长江—1000A发动机验证应用。
blocks.en: Advance capacity expansion and supply chain development for the C919 aircraft; carry out the development and application of C919 plateau and other series variants, C909 derivatives and new-energy aircraft; and accelerate technological breakthroughs for the C929 aircraft and the verification and application of the Changjiang—1000A engine.

blocks.zh: 低空装备
blocks.en: Low-altitude Equipment

blocks.zh: 加快大载重固定翼无人机、长航程垂直起降航空器等新型低空装备研制，突破智能飞行、电推进和混合动力系统等关键技术，强化低空运行管理和低成本无人机安全防控技术产品攻关应用。
blocks.en: Accelerate the development of new low-altitude equipment such as heavy-payload fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles and long-range vertical takeoff and landing aircraft; achieve breakthroughs in key technologies such as intelligent flight, electric propulsion and hybrid power systems; and strengthen breakthroughs in and the application of low-altitude operation management and low-cost unmanned aerial vehicle safety and control technologies and products.

blocks.zh: 绿色氢能
blocks.en: Green Hydrogen

blocks.zh: 提升可再生能源制氢装备水平，加快攻关验证经济安全的规模化氢储运技术，优化布局氢能基础设施，推动绿氢产业链向绿色氨醇、可持续航空燃料延伸，拓展氢能在交通、电力、工业等领域应用。
blocks.en: Improve the level of renewable energy hydrogen production equipment, accelerate breakthroughs in and verification of economical and safe large-scale hydrogen storage and transport technologies, optimize the layout of hydrogen infrastructure, extend the green hydrogen industrial chain toward green ammonia and methanol and sustainable aviation fuels, and expand the application of hydrogen in transport, power, industry and other fields.

blocks.zh: 脑机接口
blocks.en: Brain-Computer Interfaces

blocks.zh: 加快新型电极与专用芯片等基础软硬件、信号编解码算法、汉语语料数据库等关键技术攻关，推动脑机接口产品在脑疾病诊治、运动康复治疗、健康监测等领域应用。
blocks.en: Accelerate breakthroughs in key technologies such as basic software and hardware including new electrodes and dedicated chips, signal encoding and decoding algorithms, and Chinese language corpus databases, and promote the application of brain-computer interface products in brain disease diagnosis and treatment, motor rehabilitation therapy, health monitoring and other fields.

blocks.zh: 高端医疗器械
blocks.en: High-end Medical Devices

blocks.zh: 推动超高端计算机断层扫描、高分辨磁共振、放射治疗系统、智能手术机器人、生命支持设备等新型诊疗装备研发突破和规模化应用，研制重大慢性病康复、神经刺激、心血管和骨科治疗等新型植入介入器械。
blocks.en: Promote R&D breakthroughs in and the large-scale application of new diagnostic and therapeutic equipment such as ultra-high-end computed tomography scanners, high-resolution magnetic resonance imaging systems, radiotherapy systems, intelligent surgical robots and life support equipment, and develop new implantable and interventional devices for major chronic disease rehabilitation, neurostimulation, and cardiovascular and orthopedic treatment.
